newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Yangming to issue T$1.4/share dividends.
newsitem.headline: Yangming to issue T$1.4/share dividends.

text.p: Taiwan's Yangming Marine Corp said on Wednesday it would issue T$1.4 per share in dividends for fiscal 1995/96 (July/June).

A company statement said the firm's board meeting had approved the T$1.4 dividend plan, including a cash dividend of T$0.7 per share and a stock dividend, or bonus issue, of T$0.7 per share, or 70 shares for every 1,000 shares held.
The ex-dividend and ex-bonus issue will be on November 1, the statement said.
Yangming, one of Taiwan's biggest shipping firms, was privatised in February after an offer of 110 million shares, reducing its government stake to 48 percent from 56.5 percent.
